verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT is owned hardware, and first-party ROCm docs show its full AI software stack running on the user's own machine. Docs pitch a local workstation as a private alternative to cloud, list gfx1201 support for PyTorch/JAX, and document vLLM, SGLang and llama.cpp serving via Docker or pip. The open-source ROCm stack can also be built from source (TheRock) and installed offline via the runfile installer. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted AI workloads on this card (community reviews cover only gaming), and evidence on how open the driver and firmware layers are beyond the 'primarily open-source' claim.
